capabilities: Force a note's view mode with frontmatter keys (obsidianUIMode, obsidianEditingMode)
Set folder and filename-regex rules that force a mode without editing notes
Enforce a default mode when opening notes in an existing pane
Fine-tune behavior with settings like ignoring open files and debounce timeout
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.1.0 or later; release assets ship with artifact attestations verifiable via gh attestation verify.
intentEvidence: indicate through front matter that a note should always be opened in a certain view mode or editing mode
problem: Obsidian applies one global default view mode, so you cannot make specific notes always open in reading view, live preview, or source mode.
summary: Plugin that forces a note to open in a chosen view or editing mode via frontmatter keys, folder rules, filename regex rules, or a default mode.
